_instructions: Rescue batch for trade_when alpha with self-corr FAIL (0.7033 vs 0.7 limit)
Root cause: trade_when structure + close-based signal + abs(returns) trigger
Fix hierarchy: (1) rank() wrapper, (2) decay increase, (3) vwap base, (4) exit replacement
Pass criteria: Sharpe>=1.25, Fitness>=1.0, TVR<=70%, self_corr<0.7

candidates.name: rank_wrapper_decay15
candidates.description: Add rank() wrapper + increase decay to 15 — primary fix from 88Ob79jV precedent

candidates.name: rank_wrapper_decay15_vwap_base
candidates.description: rank wrapper + decay=15 + vwap replaces close as price base

candidates.name: rank_wrapper_decay20_vwap_base
candidates.description: rank wrapper + higher decay=20 + vwap — maximum smoothing

candidates.name: rank_wrapper_decay15_vol_trigger
candidates.description: rank wrapper + decay=15 + volatility-based exit replaces abs(returns) trigger

candidates.name: rank_wrapper_decay15_vwap_vol_trigger
candidates.description: Full change: rank+decay15+vwap+vol trigger — most different from original

candidates.name: no_densify_rank_decay15
candidates.description: Remove densify(sector) to simplify neutralization — tests if densify causes path dependency

candidates.name: no_densify_vwap_rank_decay15
candidates.description: No densify + vwap + rank wrapper + decay=15

candidates.name: sector_bucket_rank_decay15
candidates.description: Replace densify(sector) with densify(bucket(rank(cap), range='0.1, 1, 0.1')) — cap-based grouping

expected_outcomes.primary_target: rank_wrapper_decay15 or rank_wrapper_decay15_vwap_base — expected self_corr < 0.69 (based on 88Ob79jV precedent)
expected_outcomes.fallback_target: rank_wrapper_decay15_vol_trigger — vol-based exit may further reduce self-corr
expected_outcomes.kill_criteria: All variants with self_corr >= 0.7 should be KILL
expected_outcomes.borderline_handling: If any variant hits 0.700-0.702, run one additional decay=25 variant

notes: Key precedent: 88Ob79jV (returns/vwap family) went from self_corr 0.7224 (decay=20) to 0.6796 (decay=15 + rank wrapper)
The rank() wrapper is the confirmed mechanism for breaking time-series dependency
vwap base change is orthogonal to LLgOWZmn which uses close-based high-low range
Do NOT increase decay beyond 20 unless all <20 variants FAIL — too much smoothing destroys Fitness
